player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I assigned a high score to "Relieved" (7), which contradicts the emotional weight of the scene where Emma is forced to reject a friend and face the potential loss of their relationship. While she is relieved the confession is over, the dominant emotions are the conflict of her loyalty to her husband and the pain of hurting Sean. Next time, I will re-evaluate the scores to reflect that "Guilty" should be the highest intensity (likely 8-9) due to her fear of betraying her marriage and hurting Sean, and "Relieved" should be significantly lower (likely 2-3) as the situation remains unresolved and painful. I will also ensure "Indignant" and "Bitter" remain low, as her tone is gentle and regretful, not angry. The new scoring strategy will prioritize the internal conflict and sorrow evident in her dialogue.
